ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: ability to filter network traffic between
missing_information: The intended interpretation of 'ability' as either a noun (a capability or feature) or an adjective (having the ability). This creates two different interpretations of the requirement.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text introduces ambiguity regarding whether 'ability to filter network traffic between' refers to the routing switches having the capability or possessing the ability.
